Name: Closer Crops
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[u][size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size][/u]

This is a small but powerful mod that by default plants up to four of a seed per tilled tile for designated seed types or using an optional hotkey for any crop. 

Default designated seed types are:

[list]
[*]"472" - parsnip[/*]
[*]"476" - garlic[/*]
[*]"484" - radish[/*]
[*]"494" - beet[/*]
[*]"427" - tulip[/*]
[*]"429" - jazz[/*]
[*]"453" - poppy[/*]
[*]"455" - summer spangle[/*]
[*]"745" - strawberry[/*]
[*]"CarrotSeeds" - carrot[/*]
[/list]You can add or remove seed types in the config.json file created when first running the game with this mod (requires game restart).


[u][size=5][b]Usage[/b][/size][/u]

On planting any of the above crop types, they will by default be planted as four-per-tile. 

You can set a hotkey in the config, as either a toggle or hold, that lets the mod work on all crop types. There's also a config option to make the hotkey turn off four-per-tile planting, making all crops plant four-per-tile without the hotkey.

The mod consumes up to four seeds each time you plant a designated seed type. 

If the seed item you are holding has less than 4 seeds, it will plant whatever you have. You can add more seeds up to four, but once the crops start growing, you won't be able to add more seeds.

Crops on the same tile will grow at the same speed and be harvested together, however quality for each crop harvested will be calculated individually.

If you turn off Multiply Harvest in the config, the mod will only provide a visual change, multiplying each designated crop type by four visually, but requiring only one seed and giving only one harvest per tile.

By default, closer crops are rendered at 80% size of normal crops. This can be adjusted in the config.


[u][size=5][b]Notes[/b][/size][/u]

I recommend a mod like [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47053]Tidy Hoe Dirt[/url] [/b]to make the crops fit well on the tilled soil.

Giant crops will replace all four crops in each tile converted - giant crops convert the same number of tiles as in the vanilla game.

The game still sees each tile as having a single crop, so if you remove this mod the crops will appear and function as normal again.

Please let me know if you encounter any strange behaviour using this mod.


[u][size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size][/u]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
